budget.note: Probe was standalone (not via run_on_mx.py) and charged NO budget.

determinism_prerequisite.detail: CLAMP production renderer bitwise-deterministic + NaN-free on 5/5 views under shared-GPU amendment.

probe.method: Self-contained per-step timing probe; inlines build_optimizer/position_lr/eta_at from run_e1.py; uses comax_render_eta_ckpt (checkpointed twin) exactly as run_e1_ckpt.py monkeypatches it. 6 baseline + 6 comax training steps at 1080p on frozen room checkpoint (924550 gaussians).
probe.comax_lower_bound_basis: 6 comax steps not completed in 176s of timing loop (0 of 6 done); pure-compute lower bound >29.3s/step, before disk-stall overhead.
probe.killed_reason: manual kill after conclusive lower bound; further waiting would not change the budget-infeasibility decision.
probe.note: GPU util stayed low (0-33%) because the ckpt reference comax renderer per-Kmax torch.where loop is CPU-bound; this is inherent to the unoptimized reference oracle, not a GPU-idle artifact.

feasibility_analysis.full_e1_work: determinism_check (2x50=100 comax steps) + baseline 1000 steps + comax 1000 steps + eval on frozen test split
feasibility_analysis.margin: Full E1 lower bound (~9.6h) exceeds remaining budget (2.16h) by ~4.4x even with zero baseline/eval cost; the comax reference oracle alone (~8.95h) exceeds budget by ~4.1x.

environmental_blocker.impact: Kernel cannot flush dirty page-cache pages to the full root; processes intermittently stall in State D even with all writable paths redirected to the storage pool. GT images are read from root, so page-cache pressure from other tenants stalls even reads.
environmental_blocker.attribution: Shared multi-tenant node; bulk of root usage is other tenants data. NOT safe to delete foreign files.
environmental_blocker.mitigation_applied: Redirected all task writable paths to /mnt/storage_pool (68G free); cleared only the task own caches (pip 301M, torchinductor 790M) - insufficient.
environmental_blocker.effect_on_e1: Adds intermittent I/O stalls to any root-reading process; would further slow/reliability-degrade a multi-hour E1 run.

additional_finding.non_ckpt_comax_oom: The non-checkpoint comax_render_eta OOMs at 1080p on a CLEAN idle GPU (39.4 GiB used, full-graph retention ~30-40 GB). The checkpointed twin (comax_render_eta_ckpt) is REQUIRED for any 1080p E1 run; matches module docstring and prior co-residency OOM root cause.
additional_finding.significance: Confirms the ckpt twin is not merely a shared-GPU mitigation but a necessity at 1080p regardless of co-residency.

h0_headroom_context.e2_outlook: Even if a fast comax renderer existed, prior H0 measured ceiling is marginal against the >=2.0x render gate; E2 speed PASS is not established.

future_hypothesis.note: The reference comax renderer per-Kmax Python torch.where loop is the throughput bottleneck. A segmented-scan/vectorized equivalent (as the CUDA envelope implements) would be orders of magnitude faster. This is a METHOD CHANGE and is NOT pursued in this budget-constrained pass; recorded only as a FUTURE_HYPOTHESIS for paper-level optimization. It must preserve bitwise-exactness vs the current depth-order oracle to remain valid.

master_verdict.reason: No new preregistered scientific (performance/quality) evidence was produced. E1 full quality is budget-infeasible (reference oracle too slow); E2/E3 remain NOT_RUN. Per directive, master verdict is NOT altered by a feasibility/diagnostic analysis.

provenance.note: Feasibility probe on a fully idle GPU (no co-resident job). NO timing/performance claim; this is a cost/feasibility measurement, not an E2 result.
